plain: An engineer from NASA Eagle Works, a small NASA lab that tested unusual propulsion ideas, claims to have powered a little microchip at 1.5 kilovolts using the Casimir effect, a tiny force that appears between very close surfaces in empty space. Michels passes this on himself and does not name the engineer. If true, it would mean usable energy can be drawn from the vacuum itself.
